description: This Java class provides custom assertion methods for testing ErrorResponse objects in a testing framework, utilizing AssertJ for assertions. It helps verify properties like headers, status code, and embedded exceptions.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAssert
classes.description: Custom assertion class for ErrorResponse objects providing methods to verify properties and embedded exceptions.

methods.name: ErrorResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with the ErrorResponse instance.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that the ErrorResponse contains the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that the ErrorResponse has no DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Verifies the correlation ID in the ErrorResponse's headers.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Checks that the ErrorResponse's type matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Verifies that the status code matches the expected HttpStatusCode.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Asserts that the ErrorResponse contains the expected DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: containsDittoRuntimeExceptionOfType
methods.description: Verifies that the embedded DittoRuntimeException is of the specified type.

methods.name: dittoRuntimeExceptionHasErrorCode
methods.description: Checks that the embedded DittoRuntimeException has the expected error code.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method to verify that two values are equal with a custom error message.
